company.name: Baalbaki Chemical Industries
company.shortDescription: Baalbaki Chemical Industries produces polyester polyols and polyurethane systems.
company.description: Baalbaki Chemical Industries manufactures and distributes polyester polyols, polyurethane systems, polyurethane auxiliaries, specialty adhesives, and coatings, as well as prepolymers. Baalbaki Chemical Industries offers polyesters, bulk delivery options, and a full range of polyurethane sstems for applications such as insulation, footwear, automotive, seating, and adhesives.
